blocks.text: This chapter explained how computer networks are built and how they work, keep running and stay safe. The table brings together its main terms.

blocks.caption: Chapter 1 key terms
rows: Computer network
Connected computers and devices that share data, resources and services
Network architecture
The design and organisation of a network: how devices are connected and how communication takes place
Network topology
The arrangement of devices and connections, such as bus, star, ring, mesh or tree
LAN
Connects devices in a small area such as a home, school, office or computer lab
WAN
Connects networks over large areas such as cities, countries or continents
Internet
The largest public network, joining millions of devices and networks worldwide
Networking devices
Hardware such as switches, routers, modems, NICs and access points that connect devices and manage communication
OSI model
A seven-layer model of how data travels from one device to another
Network protocol
Rules that control how data is sent, received and understood
IP address
A unique address that identifies a device on a network
Subnetting
Dividing a large network into smaller networks for better management and security
Network security
Methods that protect networks, devices and data from unauthorised access, misuse or attack

items: Networks: types (LAN, WAN, Internet), devices, topologies, OSI layers, protocols.
Addressing: IPv4, IPv6, subnetting, NAT; home Wi-Fi and its security.
Running a network: diagnostics, performance, load balancing, security, backup, usability versus security.
